serviceDetail.step1Body: Pick a service and a time. You never have to choose a professional yourself.
serviceDetail.step2Body: Your request goes to every available verified professional nearby. The first to accept is assigned.
serviceDetail.step3Body: Follow their arrival live. Work starts and ends only when you share a 4-digit code.

serviceDetail.faq1A: Members of a registered cooperative society, verified by their federation before they can accept any job.
serviceDetail.faq2Q: Can I choose a specific professional?
serviceDetail.faq2A: No — and that is deliberate. Requests go to everyone eligible nearby, so work is shared fairly instead of concentrating on a few names.
serviceDetail.faq3A: A fixed share of every booking goes into the federation's welfare fund, which supports workers' insurance and benefits.
serviceDetail.faq4Q: Is the emergency charge taken by the platform?
serviceDetail.faq4A: No. The entire emergency amount goes to the professional who takes the urgent job.
